methodology.scope: Germany only; NUTS 3 regions; 2024 industrial-site records and 2025 population.
methodology.exposure: Count of sites in PFAS-associated industrial proxy sectors: chemicals, metals/surface treatment, paper/wood and textile.
methodology.consequence: Eurostat population on 1 January by NUTS 3 region.
methodology.score: sqrt((100 × industrial_site_count / German maximum) × (100 × population / German maximum)).
methodology.limitation: Indicative pre-prioritisation only. An industrial site is a proxy for potential pressure, not evidence of PFAS contamination, human exposure, or regulatory non-compliance.
